* Assist Office Administrator with maintaining the monthly AUMC calendar.

* Coordinate preparation of worship materials (bulletins, scriptures, slides, etc.)

* Familiarity with church operations.
* Strong grammatical skills, proofreading and editing, and copywriting

* Familiarity with ProPresenter preferred.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse groups of people and maintain positive relations within the work and Church environment.
* Strong social media experience and knowledge.
* Graphic design and videography experience recommended.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud Suite preferred
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Pay: $21\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 12\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

jobs.description:

The sales team is also expanding its business\-development efforts for Cadence, an AI platform used by law firms and claims organizations to review and analyze workers’ compensation matters.  

Sullivan on Comp is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented **Account Management \& Renewals Coordinator** to provide direct support to the Account Executive responsible for renewals, account management, customer retention, and account growth.  

The primary focus of this role is to ensure that renewals, customer requests, account changes, documentation, and follow\-up activities are handled accurately and on time, while promptly identifying matters that require Account Executive involvement.  

**Compensation:*** $29 – $35/hour ($60,320 – $72,800 annually)
* Annual performance incentive of 5% target / 7\.5% maximum
This position is classified as non\-exempt and is eligible for overtime in accordance with applicable law.  
* 
**Travel \& Work Location*** Candidate must reside in CA.
* This position can be performed primarily in a remote environment, with up to 15% \- 25% travel.
Travel may include but is not limited to 2\-3 meetings in SoCal Office, approximately 10 industry conferences or trade shows each lasting 2\-4 days, and additional occasional business travel on an as\-needed basis.  

* 

**Daily Objectives:*** Manage the end\-to\-end renewal process, including tracking upcoming renewals, coordinating customer communications, processing standard renewal requests, and maintaining accurate renewal status in HubSpot.
* Monitor customer accounts and proactively identify renewals, retention risks, account changes, or nonstandard situations requiring Account Executive involvement.
* Maintain accurate group\-account, subscription, billing, user, and account information while coordinating routine account updates with internal teams.
* Support customer retention and growth initiatives by identifying potential upgrade, expansion, and Cadence opportunities and escalating them to the Account Executive.
* Prepare quotes, contracts, renewal documents, account reviews, and related documentation while tracking outstanding forms, requests, and customer commitments through completion.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, customer interactions, renewal activities, forecasts, reports, and account\-status tracking to support informed decision\-making.
* Conduct routine customer follow\-up, respond to standard account and renewal inquiries, and help maintain engagement between strategic account conversations.
* Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of customer requests and a positive client experience.
* Provide actionable account intelligence by identifying upcoming renewals, accounts requiring attention, retention opportunities, and customer trends that support account management strategy.
Support industry conferences, trade shows, and firm events through event preparation, on\-site participation, customer engagement, lead follow\-up, and business travel as needed.  
* 
**Skills \& Experience:*** 2\+ years of experience in sales and/or business development in the Workers’ Compensation, Insurance, Legal Tech, SAAS, or similar Legal Services industry.
* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM.
* Experience providing client activation and renewal support to account management, sales, or customer success teams.
* Strong organizational skills, highly detail\-oriented, excellent time management, and holding strong follow\-through abilities.
* Strong multi\-tasking abilities, ability to work independently, and proactively work as part of a team.
* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, databases, and sales systems.
* Strong customer service and ability to communicate professionally on the phone and via email.
* Exercise good judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated.
Be willing and able to travel for conferences, trade shows, and firm meetings.  
* 

**Health \& Wellness*** Medical plan options including **Kaiser Permanente** HMO, **Cigna** EPO, and **Cigna** PPO
* Dental coverage through **Delta Dental** with DHMO and PPO options
* **Vision** coverage through VSP
* Firm\-Paid **Life/AD\&D** (up to $150k) \& Long\-term Disability ( **LTD** ) Insurance.
* Firm\-Paid Employee Assistance Program ( **EAP** ) offering confidential support.
**Retirement \& Voluntary Benefits*** **401(k)** retirement plan with employer contribution.
* **Critical Illness** , **Accident** , and **Hospital Indemnity Coverage** , available at group rates.
* Flexible Spending Account ( **FSA** ) and Dependent Care Assistance Program ( **DCAP** ) options for eligible pre\-tax expenses.
* Voluntary short\-term disability ( **STD** ) coverage.
* Supplemental **Life and AD\&D Insurance** .

jobs.title: Community Marketing Coordinator- Fatburger
jobs.description:
Description:

FAT Brands Inc is a leading global franchising company that develops and grows fast casual, quick\-service, and casual dining concepts around the world — a portfolio of 11 brands, including Round Table Pizza®, Fatburger, Marble Slab Creamery, Johnny Rockets, Fazoli’s, Great American Cookies, Buffalo’s Cafe \& Express, Hurricane Grill \& Wings, Native Grill \& Wings, Pretzelmaker, and Ponderosa and Bonanza Steakhouses, spanning more than 1,700 units worldwide.


The Community Marketing Coordinator is an integral part of the Fatburger Marketing team at FAT brands, responsible for bringing the brand to life at the local restaurant level. This role combines hands\-on execution with strategic problem\-solving, helping franchisees identify and activate marketing opportunities that drive traffic, build community connections, and support profitable sales growth.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, with the ability to manage the details while also seeing the bigger picture. They should be comfortable working directly with franchises, navigating multiple priorities, and finding creative solutions when a playbook doesn't already exist.


This role will support local store marketing problems, new restaurant openings, community events, franchisee marketing requests and local partnerships while using market, competitive and sales insights to identify opportunities and recommend effective local marketing strategies.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  



* Assist in developing and executing local marketing plans that drive awareness, traffic and profitable sales, tailored to individual restaurant and market needs.
* Serve as a day\-to\-day marketing resource to franchisees, helping identify opportunities, develop market\-specific strategies and execute events, partnerships and community initiatives.
* Coordinate New Restaurant Marketing Plans and all marketing\-related activities from pre\-opening through launch.
* Lead local activations, events, and partnerships while ensuring all marketing remains on\-brand and aligned with broader Fatburger objectives.
* Coordinate creative requests from intake through final delivery, provide guidance on best practices and ensure franchisees have the tools and resources needed to execute effectively.
* Leverage sales, market and competitive data to identify opportunities, measure results and inform future local marketing strategies.
* Assists the Digital Team with CRM platforms, including websites, SMS, e\-clubs, and app\-based loyalty programs.
* Responsible for maintaining and updating ship lists, store location lists, and location listings management tools.
* Maintain budgets, project timelines, store/location information, marketing resources and other tools necessary to keep local programs organized and moving forward.
* Assists with Administrative Duties such as maintaining a budget, agendas, notes, and action items for meetings.


Requirements:  



* 2\+ years of marketing, local store marketing, franchise marketing, restaurant marketing or agency experience preferred.
* Experience working with franchisees, field teams, operators, or multiple stakeholders is a plus.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, deadlines and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both corporate teams and franchise partners.
* Highly resourceful and solutions\-oriented; comfortable figuring things out, navigating ambiguity and taking initiatives without being asked.
* Strategic thinker who can understand a business challenge, identify opportunities and recommend practical marketing solutions
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through, with the ability to move projects from idea to execution
* Comfortable working with basic sales, market and competitive data translating insights into actionable recommendations
* Strong relationship\-building skills and the confidence to work directly with franchisees and restaurant operators
* Creative thinker who understands how to make a national brand relevant within individual communities
* Proficiency with project management and marketing tools; experience with Asana, Google Business Profile, social platforms, CRM/loyalty platforms and third\-party delivery platforms is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News \& World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second\-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  

  

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.  

The NCI\-designated Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (CFCCC) is a campus\-wide multidisciplinary matrix organization whose goal is to promote and enhance cancer\-relevant research and patient care at UC Irvine. The CFCCC provides research resources to its \~175 members engaged in research and offers multidisciplinary cancer care to its patients.  


Responsibilities:

Under supervision of the Clinical Research Manager of the Clinical Trials Unit, the Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator supports the clinical research efforts of the Cancer Center by providing comprehensive coordination and data management of multiple Phase II\-IV cancer\-related protocols according to Good Clinical Practices (GCP), internal standard operating procedure (SOPs), and University policies and procedures.
  

  

The incumbent is responsible for supporting and coordinating all aspects of the cancer\-related trials (Phase II\-IV) for protocol specific requirements, research procedures, research chart preparation, data collection, and record keeping. Attends clinic to assist the Principal Investigator (PI) with recruitment, screening, consenting, administering questionnaires, answer research patient questions, schedule appointments, etc.

jobs.title: Service Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and customer\-focused Service Account Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will develop and maintain positive relationships within assigned customer accounts, overseeing the sales process, and acting as the primary point of contact to retain and grow these accounts. You will maintain regular communication with customers, coordinate with the Service team to ensure satisfaction, promptly address concerns and advocate for customers when performance or billing issues arise. Assigned accounts are generally larger and more complex.


**Position Details**


* Primarily responsible for growing our overall service business by prospecting in assigned market territory to develop and cultivate new “existing building” “owner direct” customers.
* Primary goal is to sell new service maintenance agreements and truck\-based service and project work.
* Proactively manages the service sales process to close sales, including prospecting, qualifying, customer’s setup and procurement process, proposals, presentations, as well as handling questions and objections.
* Develops and maintains positive relationships within assigned customer accounts. Oversees the sales process and acts as a “One Southland” point of contact for customers, engaging any internal teams or support necessary to allow for additional business development.
* Continuously generates new sales by using existing and potential customer networks and social networking. Identifies new business opportunities acting as the customer’s building solutions partner for all areas of locally provided service offerings.
* Mentors less\-experienced Service Account Managers.


**Qualifications**


* Two\-year relevant degree or equivalent training and experience, such as trade\-level training or industry experience
* 3\+ years in direct relevant experience
* Strong knowledge of service policies, procedures and capabilities
* Strong verbal and written communication, including presentation skills
* Strong customer service skills and ability to develop customer relationships
* Demonstrated sales skills in prospecting, qualifying, proposing and closing sales and capable of developing and managing large accounts (existing and new)
* Strong collaboration skills internally and externally, with strong problem\-solving abilities
* Frequent travel to job sites within assigned region
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

Fujifilm’s Data Storage Solutions division provides magnetic storage tape to customers around the world, supporting mission critical data retention needs across a wide range of industries. Magnetic tape is recognized as a core component of modern data center infrastructure, valued for its reliability, cost efficiency, and low power consumption in large scale and long\-term data archival.


As AI workloads drive data volumes to grow at an unprecedented pace, demand for Fujifilm’s magnetic tape is expanding rapidly. To further accelerate this growth and strengthen our engagement with key hyperscale customers, we are adding an experienced Account Manager to our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maximizing revenue, building and maintaining long term relationships, and serving as a primary point of contact for purchasing, supply chain, engineering, and related functions within major hyperscale accounts.

**This position is remote and based on the West Coast.**
